title: Species-Resolved Scaling of Azimuthal Anisotropy: Constraining Attenuation, Collective Expansion, and Hadronic Dynamics in Hydrodynamic Simulations
summary: Species-resolved azimuthal anisotropy scaling functions are constructed from identified particle $v_2$ and $v_3$ obtained from event-by-event iEBE-VISHNU simulations for Pb+Pb collisions at $\sqrt{s_{NN}}=2.76$ and $5.02$~TeV. The scaling functions exhibit a robust collapse across transverse momentum, centrality, particle species, and beam energy, indicating a common and tightly constrained scaling structure.
